$comment: The default roles of coai v2 (server.md §2, §19, §20): which model each external role runs, per MAIN-AI vendor. coai-mcp embeds this file (src_mcp/src/CoaiMcp.csproj, Roles/RoleDefaults.cs) and answers it through the `roles` tool and `coai-mcp --roles [--format json|claude-hook]`; a person's COAI_ROLES_* settings override it. A role's value is an ORDERED list of {model, vendor}: the first entry is the model, the later ones are the FAILOVER order (§20). Names here are the OWNER's (§2, §20) and names this repository already holds; a vendor with no measured model list is left EMPTY with a note, never filled with a guess. `whenVendorRow` makes an entry apply only when the person has a configured reviewer row on that vendor's runtime.

important.source: server.md §20 names it (important: fable, then codex astra); the repository holds `codex-astra` as a codex model in shared/runtime-capabilities.json (read-outside-bare cells) and in Tools.cs

codex.note: no measured model list for codex as the main AI: the defaults are empty, and a person's COAI_ROLES_MODELS and COAI_ROLES_BANDS fill them

agy.note: no measured model list for agy as the main AI: the defaults are empty, and a person's COAI_ROLES_MODELS and COAI_ROLES_BANDS fill them
